spans.s:
(इ) घुषि r. 1st cl. (घुषते)
To render beautiful or brilliant.
(इर) घुषिर r. 1st cl. (घोषति)
To do any act except manifest sentiment by sound.
r. 10th cl. (घोषयति)
1 To manifest sentiment or thought by sound, to speak, to affirm, to declare or proclaim.
2 To make various sounds.
3 To praise.
With आङ् prefixed,
To weep incessantly.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Manifested by sound, proclaimed.
E.
घुष as above, affix क्त, इट् augment; also घुष्ट.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Sounded, proclaimed.
E.
घुष to sound, क्त aff.

n. (-न्नं)
Food given away by proclamation.
E.
घुष्ठ, and अङ्ग food.

n. (-णं)
Saffron.
E.
घुषि to beautify, ऋणच्त aff.
